svg.text: Prefill speed as the prompt grows
Mac Studio M5 Ultra 512 GB. One user, 512-token replies. Median of 5 runs to 128K, of 3 at 512K and 1M.
Prefill is prompt tokens over the time to the first token. The Qwen3.8 27B engines here serve it to 262,144 tokens, so 512K and 1M are not shown.
Each model at the best setup I found. mlx-serve 26.11.2, oMLX 0.7.3 and main 624cff0e, TensorFold 1.2.8. Runs 16 to 18 Nov 2026.
